steps: Prepare two registered stored projects and an active map whose Collector account is not first in Android account order
verify sync_all_projects defaults true and add a detectable server change only to the inactive project
make one required account fail and run manual sync twice rapidly
verify the active Collector account is first in the manual account queue
inspect both project databases without switching the visible map while the queue drains
leave and reopen the drawer and omit one lifecycle broadcast while checking spinner recovery plus weighted progress without percent text during real push-download-apply work
repeat a new run with sync_all_projects false and then a layer-only run
recover one persisted failed target while false remains selected
inspect each project clock and retained pair
try a project switch and choose interruption
value.expected: With sync_all_projects true one serial pipeline visits all trusted loaded projects and keeps the active map and its draft unchanged; false limits a new full run and a layer-only request to the open project, while an exact persisted recovery target still selects its registered owner. A failed project/account retains its pair without suppressing later projects; a second full sync is refused. The active Collector account retains manual priority. Spinner state recovers from worker plus lease state even if a lifecycle broadcast is missed; its progress ring uses weighted layers and real push-download-apply work without percent text, rewind or premature100% during a large snapshot. Each project clock requires its own required accounts, children, ready-outbox and cleanup success. Interruption waits for real owner release and enabled schedules are restored without duplicates. This corrected source oracle replaces only the obsolete active-project-only expectation; native execution in the29October depth audit is NOT_RUN.
